_doc: Single source of truth for the RoArm-M3 3-camera rig (lerobot 0.5.2). Read by record AND eval via camera_setup.py so the two ALWAYS match (record<->eval consistency). Logical names: wrist (eye-in-hand), side (fixed scene, from the side), top_front (RealSense, top-down from the front). Built 2026-05-30.
_doc_fps: DATASET/LOOP fps = 30 depuis le reflash 1 Mbps du 31/05 (state read ~42 Hz). Unifié record<->eval (commit 0f772b7). Per-camera capture_fps = 30 aussi -> plus de décimation.
_doc_resolution: 640x480 = 4:3 = ACT/ALOHA convention (our from-scratch ACT keeps native resolution: ResNet has no internal resize). VLAs (SmolVLA 512, MolmoAct) downscale themselves. No high-res superset: ACT would silently train on 4x tokens + record<->eval must match exactly.
_doc_depth: RealSense depth is dumped IN PARALLEL as 16-bit lossless PNG (mm) under <dataset_root>/depth/<cam>/episode_NNNNNN/frame_NNNNNN.png. lerobot 0.5.2 cannot store uint16 depth in a v3 dataset (image/video = 3ch 8-bit only; h264 would destroy the mm). The v3 dataset stays pure RGB; depth stays metrically intact + re-alignable for MolmoAct.
_doc_depth_range: D455F is a LONG-range sensor (D405 is the usual close-range one). At 640x480 disparity_shift=0: Min-Z 34cm, 72% coverage. Measured 2026-05-30: cubes at 73cm, arm clearance to the top cam never below 40cm > 34cm -> shift=0 covers the whole work zone, keeps 4:3 homogeneous. DO NOT add disparity_shift here: at 640 a shift of 50 over-shifts and KILLS mid-range coverage (72%->36%). If the top cam is ever lowered so something comes within 34cm, switch top_front to 848x480 (16:9) + disparity_shift 50 (Min-Z 24cm, 69% cov) via rs400_advanced_mode set_depth_table.

wrist._doc: Eye-in-hand. NO rotation since the 2026-05-30 wrist_roll re-zero. Chemin by-path KERNEL (stable, zéro règle udev — les symlinks /dev/video_wrist sont morts au reboot du 10/06). PCIe 75:00.0 = son contrôleur dédié. Identifiée VISUELLEMENT le 12/06 (mâchoires Gripper B visibles).
wrist._doc_controls: Voie A: freeze WB (kills the tint drift); KEEP auto_exposure=3 (aperture-priority) because these webcams expose NO manual gain in V4L2 -> a fixed exposure goes dark. dynamic_framerate=0 keeps fps stable.

side._doc: Fixed scene camera, side view. Chemin by-path KERNEL (stable, zéro règle udev). PCIe 76:00.0 = son contrôleur dédié. Identifiée VISUELLEMENT le 12/06 (table + bras + bac bleu). ⚠ by-path = stable tant qu'on ne rebranche pas sur un autre port physique.

top_front._doc: RealSense D455F, top-down from the front (MolmoAct-style overhead). use_depth opens the z16 stream; dump_depth writes it as parallel 16-bit PNG (see depth_dir).
top_front._doc_options: settle_then_lock: let auto-exposure settle on the scene, read the value, then lock AE off at that value (preserves correct brightness). WB forced to 4600 to match the USB cams as closely as a different sensor allows.
